title: Bus envelope
description: The JSON-RPC 2.0 shapes of every message on the bus and the operator socket. One message is one JSON object per line.

Request.description: Used for RPC calls, hook calls, bus.init and bus.shutdown. Answered by exactly one Response with the same id.

id.description: Chosen by the sender, unique among its outstanding requests on the connection. rbtcd assigns its own id when forwarding.

params.description: Always a JSON object (named parameters only); its schema is the RPC's, hook's or control message's.

from.description: Set by rbtcd on requests it delivers: the caller's daemon name, operator, or node. Subdaemons do not set it.

Notification.description: Used for events and bus control messages. Never answered.

params.description: Always a JSON object; its schema is the event's or control message's.

Response.description: The answer to a Request. It has exactly one of result and error.

id.description: The id of the request it answers.

result.description: The result; its schema is the RPC's, hook's or control message's.

error.message: no block at height 99999999 on the active chain

Error.description: A failed request. Codes are listed in docs/architecture/rpc.md.

data.description: Machine-readable detail, usually an object with a reason field.
